qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.reside.en: The HTTPS origin of the Kubernetes API server that the `kubernetes-workspace` provisioner calls for `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.resident-workspaces`, together with `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.resident-kubernetes-token-file` and `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.resident-kubernetes-ca-file`. Startup refuses resident Workspaces without it, and refuses a URL that is not `https` or has a path, credentials, query or fragment. The resident-retirement maintenance command reads it too.
qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.reside.zh: `kubernetes-workspace` provisioner 为 `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.resident-workspaces` 调用的 Kubernetes API server 的 HTTPS origin，需与 `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.resident-kubernetes-token-file`、`qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.resident-kubernetes-ca-file` 一起配置。配置了常驻 Workspace 却未设置此项，或 URL 不是 `https`、带有路径、凭据、查询串或片段时，启动时拒绝。常驻 Workspace 回收维护命令也会读取此项。

qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.reside.en: Path to a PEM or DER file of X.509 CA certificates that the server trusts, instead of the JVM defaults, for TLS to the Kubernetes API named by `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.resident-kubernetes-api-url`. Required when `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.resident-workspaces` is set; an unreadable file or one without certificates fails startup. The `resident-retirement` admin command reads it too.
qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.reside.zh: 服务端连接 `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.resident-kubernetes-api-url` 所指的 Kubernetes API 时用于校验 TLS 的 X.509 CA 证书文件路径（PEM 或 DER），只信任其中的证书，不使用 JVM 默认信任库。设置了 `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.resident-workspaces` 时必填；文件不可读或不含证书时启动失败。管理命令 `resident-retirement` 也会读取它。

qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.reside.en: Path to a file holding the bearer token the server sends to the Kubernetes API to manage resident Workspace Pods. The file holds a secret; it is re-read on every request, so the token can be rotated in place, and it must contain at most 16 KiB of letters, digits and `._~-`. Required when `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.resident-workspaces` is set; the `resident-retirement` admin command reads it too.
qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.reside.zh: 保存 Bearer 令牌的文件路径，服务端用该令牌调用 Kubernetes API 管理常驻 Workspace 的 Pod。文件内容是密钥；每次请求都会重新读取，因此可以原地轮换，内容最多 16 KiB，只能包含字母、数字和 `._~-`。设置了 `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.resident-workspaces` 时必填；管理命令 `resident-retirement` 也会读取它。

qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.reside.en: The Workspaces served by dedicated resident Kubernetes Pods on CSI storage, set in a configuration file (YAML) as a list. Each entry has `workspace-id`, `workspace-generation` (1 or more), `registration` (the registered CSI storage: `tenant-id`, `storage-id`, `cluster-domain`, `namespace`, `pvc-name`, `pvc-uid`, `pv-name`, `pv-uid`, `driver`, `volume-handle`, `backend-domain`, `disk-serial`, `mount-root`, `revision`), `protection` (`namespace-uid`, `policy-name`, `policy-uid`, `policy-generation`, `binding-name`, `binding-uid`, `binding-generation`), `image` (pinned as `name@sha256:<64 hex>`), `command` (1 to 32 arguments: the executable and CLI path) and `artifacts` (up to 48 ConfigMaps, each with `config-map-name`, `uid` and `sha256`). A non-empty list needs the `kubernetes-workspace` provisioner with its three `resident-kubernetes-*` settings, `workspace` isolation and Workspace files, and refuses Workspace mounts, SSH nodes, trusted reboot or verified Workspace recovery, child Workspaces and Workspace Shell. Each tenant Workspace and each volume may appear once, and each `registration` must match a registered CSI storage record.
qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.reside.zh: 由专属常驻 Kubernetes Pod 在 CSI 存储上服务的 Workspace 列表，在配置文件（YAML）中设置。每项包含 `workspace-id`、`workspace-generation`（不小于 1）、`registration`（已登记的 CSI 存储：`tenant-id`、`storage-id`、`cluster-domain`、`namespace`、`pvc-name`、`pvc-uid`、`pv-name`、`pv-uid`、`driver`、`volume-handle`、`backend-domain`、`disk-serial`、`mount-root`、`revision`）、`protection`（`namespace-uid`、`policy-name`、`policy-uid`、`policy-generation`、`binding-name`、`binding-uid`、`binding-generation`）、`image`（以 `name@sha256:<64 hex>` 固定摘要）、`command`（1 到 32 个参数，即可执行文件和 CLI 路径）以及 `artifacts`（最多 48 个 ConfigMap，每个含 `config-map-name`、`uid` 和 `sha256`）。列表非空时，需要 `kubernetes-workspace` provisioner 及其三项 `resident-kubernetes-*` 设置、`workspace` 隔离和 Workspace 文件，且不能同时配置 Workspace mount、SSH 节点、可信重启恢复或已验证 Workspace 恢复、子 Workspace 和 Workspace Shell，否则启动时拒绝。每个租户 Workspace 和每个卷只能出现一次，且每个 `registration` 必须与已登记的 CSI 存储记录一致。

qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.retent.en: How many records one retention tick may handle: it caps the bindings scanned, the child records scanned and the total rows deleted per tick. Must be between 1 and 1000; checked at startup even while retention is off.
qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.retent.zh: 每轮保留期清理最多处理的记录数：同时限制每轮扫描的绑定数、扫描的子记录数和删除的总行数。取值须在 1 到 1000 之间；即使未启用清理也会在启动时校验，越界则启动时拒绝。

qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.retent.en: Whether the server periodically deletes old terminal Runtime records (tool executions, Runtime Sessions and bindings) from the database, in bounded batches on its own scheduler. Takes effect only when `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.enabled` is also true. It never stops workers or deletes Workspace files, and it keeps records that are still referenced, such as recovery records, Workspace holders and unsettled child lineage.
qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.retent.zh: 是否在独立调度线程上按有限批次，定期从数据库删除已终结的旧 Runtime 记录（工具执行、Runtime Session 和绑定）。仅当 `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.enabled` 也为 true 时生效。它不会停止 worker，也不删除 Workspace 文件，并保留仍被引用的记录，例如恢复记录、Workspace 持有者和尚未结算的子 Session 谱系。

qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.retent.en: How long a terminal Runtime record must have been inactive before retention may delete it: a binding or Runtime Session is measured from its last activity, a tool execution from when it settled or was abandoned. A suffix-less number binds as days. Must be at least `1ms`; checked at startup even while retention is off.
qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.retent.zh: 已终结的 Runtime 记录至少要闲置多久才可被保留期清理删除：绑定和 Runtime Session 从最后活动时间算起，工具执行从结算或放弃的时间算起。不带单位的数字按天解析。至少为 `1ms`；即使未启用清理也会在启动时校验，不满足则启动时拒绝。

qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.retent.en: How long the retention job waits after one tick finishes before it starts the next. A suffix-less number binds as milliseconds. Must be at least `1ms`; checked at startup even while retention is off.
qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.retent.zh: 保留期清理任务在一轮结束后、开始下一轮前的等待时间。不带单位的数字按毫秒解析。至少为 `1ms`；即使未启用清理也会在启动时校验，不满足则启动时拒绝。

qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.sessio.en: Whether creating a Workspace-bound Session without initial input starts its Runtime worker right away instead of at the first Turn. Requires `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.bound-session-isolation-class` set to `workspace` and no `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.ssh.nodes`; startup refuses it otherwise and with external provisioners. Has no effect while Workspace files are unavailable.
qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.sessio.zh: 创建不带初始输入的 Workspace 绑定 Session 时，是否立即启动其 Runtime worker，而不是等到第一个 Turn。要求 `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.bound-session-isolation-class` 为 `workspace` 且未配置 `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.ssh.nodes`，否则启动时拒绝；使用外部 provisioner 时同样启动时拒绝。Workspace 文件不可用时不起作用。

qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.sessio.en: Whether a Workspace Session may be created in its own Git worktree of the Workspace repository, checked out from an optional local base ref under `.qwen-managed-worktrees` on a new `worktree-managed-<id>` branch. Takes effect only with `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.enabled`, `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.durable-local-process`, the `local-process` provisioner and `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.bound-session-isolation-class` set to `session`, on a non-Windows host whose JVM uses UTF-8 file names; otherwise worktree requests are refused with `worktree_unsupported`.
qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.sessio.zh: 是否允许 Workspace Session 在 Workspace 仓库的独立 Git worktree 中创建：从可选的本地 base ref 检出到 `.qwen-managed-worktrees` 下，并新建 `worktree-managed-<id>` 分支。仅当启用 `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.enabled` 和 `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.durable-local-process`、使用 `local-process` provisioner、`qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.bound-session-isolation-class` 为 `session`，且主机不是 Windows、JVM 文件名编码为 UTF-8 时才生效；否则 worktree 请求以 `worktree_unsupported` 拒绝。

qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.ssh.en.en: Whether SSH Workspaces are offered: an actor listed in a node's `access` may browse that node's allowed roots and register a directory there as a Workspace; while off, those routes answer `404 ssh_runtime_disabled`. Startup refuses it without `qwen.managed-agent.harness.workspace-files-enabled` or without `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.ssh.nodes`, with an external provisioner, and under the `managed-local` profile.
qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.ssh.en.zh: 是否提供 SSH Workspace：节点 `access` 中列出的 actor 可以浏览该节点允许的根目录，并把其中的目录登记为 Workspace；关闭时这些路由返回 `404 ssh_runtime_disabled`。未开启 `qwen.managed-agent.harness.workspace-files-enabled` 或未配置 `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.ssh.nodes`、使用外部 provisioner，或处于 `managed-local` profile 时，启动时拒绝。

qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.ssh.no.en: The SSH Runtime nodes, set in a configuration file (YAML) as a list. Each entry has `node-id` and `display-name`, `ssh-host` (a host alias of the server account's SSH configuration), the absolute node paths `node-executable`, `qwen-entry` and `state-directory`, `allowed-roots` (at least one absolute directory Workspaces may be registered under), `publication-port` (the node's loopback port that tool publication is forwarded to over SSH), `qwen-version` (required; must equal the version the node reports) and `access` (the `tenant-id` and `actor-id` pairs that may use the node). Startup refuses an invalid entry. With nodes set, `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.service-base-url` must be an `http` URL.
qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.ssh.no.zh: SSH Runtime 节点，以列表形式写在配置文件（YAML）中。每一项包含 `node-id` 和 `display-name`；`ssh-host`（服务端账号 SSH 配置中的主机别名）；节点上的绝对路径 `node-executable`、`qwen-entry` 和 `state-directory`；`allowed-roots`（至少一个绝对目录，Workspace 只能登记在其下）；`publication-port`（节点上的 loopback 端口，工具发布通过 SSH 转发到这里）；`qwen-version`（必填，必须与节点报告的版本一致）；`access`（允许使用该节点的 `tenant-id` 与 `actor-id` 组合）。条目无效时启动时拒绝。配置了节点后，`qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.service-base-url` 必须是 `http` URL。

qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.state-.en: The directory where the local-process Broker keeps worker registrations and recovery records; workers also run with it as their working directory. Required when `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.provisioner` is `local-process`. With `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.durable-local-process` it is created if missing, provided its parent exists, and must be owned by the server account with mode `0700`, have no symlinks in its path, and lie outside `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.workspace-cwd`, `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.workspace-creation-root` and every `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.workspace-mounts` root; startup refuses otherwise. A relative path resolves against the server's working directory.
qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.state-.zh: local-process Broker 存放 worker 登记和恢复记录的目录；worker 也以它作为工作目录。`qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.provisioner` 为 `local-process` 时必填。启用 `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.durable-local-process` 时，目录不存在会自动创建（其父目录须已存在），且必须归服务账号所有、权限为 `0700`、路径中不含符号链接，并位于 `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.workspace-cwd`、`qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.workspace-creation-root` 和每个 `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.workspace-mounts` 根目录之外，否则启动时拒绝。相对路径按服务端的工作目录解析。

qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.static.en: The HTTP(S) origin of the already-running Runtime worker that the `static` provisioner hands to every Session; an origin only, without path, credentials, query or fragment. Required, with `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.static-token`, when `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.provisioner` is `static`, which also requires `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.isolation-class` set to `workspace` and `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.trusted-local-reboot-recovery` set to false.
qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.static.zh: `static` provisioner 交给每个 Session 的已在运行的 Runtime worker 的 HTTP(S) 源地址；只能是源（origin），不得包含路径、凭据、查询串或片段。`qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.provisioner` 为 `static` 时，与 `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.static-token` 一起必填；该模式还要求 `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.isolation-class` 为 `workspace`、`qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.trusted-local-reboot-recovery` 为 false。

qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.static.en: The lease epoch of the static Runtime worker; the Broker sends it with each request and the worker's attestation must report the same value. Startup refuses a negative value. Read only when `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.provisioner` is `static`.
qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.static.zh: static Runtime worker 租约的 epoch；Broker 在每个请求中携带它，worker 的证明（attestation）必须回报相同的值。为负数时启动时拒绝。仅当 `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.provisioner` 为 `static` 时读取。

qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.static.en: The lease ID of the static Runtime worker; the Broker sends it with each request and the worker's attestation must report the same value. A non-empty string of at most 512 characters. Read only when `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.provisioner` is `static`.
qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.static.zh: static Runtime worker 租约的 ID；Broker 在每个请求中携带它，worker 的证明（attestation）必须回报相同的值。须为非空字符串，最长 512 个字符。仅当 `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.provisioner` 为 `static` 时读取。

qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.static.en: The Runtime instance ID of the static Runtime worker's lease; the worker's attestation must report the same value. A non-empty string of at most 512 characters. Read only when `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.provisioner` is `static`.
qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.static.zh: static Runtime worker 租约中的 Runtime 实例 ID；worker 的证明（attestation）必须回报相同的值。须为非空字符串，最长 512 个字符。仅当 `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.provisioner` 为 `static` 时读取。

qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.static.en: The bearer token the Broker presents to the static Runtime worker. A secret; saved bindings store it encrypted with the Runtime credential key (`qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.credential-key`). Required when `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.provisioner` is `static`; at most 512 characters.
qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.static.zh: Broker 访问 static Runtime worker 时出示的 Bearer 令牌，属于密钥；已保存的绑定用 Runtime 凭据密钥（`qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.credential-key`）加密存储它。`qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.provisioner` 为 `static` 时必填，最长 512 个字符。

qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.token.en: The bearer token the Hosted Harness presents to the embedded Runtime Broker's private listener; it also authorizes the loopback-only external storage registration endpoint. A secret. Required when `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.enabled` is true; at most 512 characters. It can come from `qwen.managed-agent.harness.credentials-file` (`QWEN_MANAGED_RUNTIME_BROKER_TOKEN`) instead; setting it in both places is refused at startup.
qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.token.zh: Hosted Harness 访问内嵌 Runtime Broker 私有监听端口时出示的 Bearer 令牌；它也用于授权仅限回环地址的外部存储登记接口。属于密钥。`qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.enabled` 为 true 时必填，最长 512 个字符。也可以改由 `qwen.managed-agent.harness.credentials-file` 中的 `QWEN_MANAGED_RUNTIME_BROKER_TOKEN` 提供；两处同时设置时启动时拒绝。

qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.truste.en: Whether, after a whole-host reboot on Linux, the Broker treats the changed kernel boot ID as proof that the original local workers stopped, and clears the holders of their saved Runtime bindings once every execution is terminal. It scans 8 saved bindings every 5 seconds and never starts a replacement worker or replays an execution. Requires `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.durable-local-process` and the `local-process` provisioner; startup refuses it otherwise, on macOS and with resident Workspaces.
qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.truste.zh: Linux 主机整机重启后，Broker 是否把内核 boot ID 的变化视为原本地 worker 已停止的证据，并在所有执行都已终结后清除这些已保存 Runtime 绑定的持有者。它每 5 秒扫描 8 个已保存的绑定，从不启动替代 worker，也不重放执行。要求 `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.durable-local-process` 和 `local-process` provisioner；不满足条件、在 macOS 上或配置了常驻 Workspace 时启动时拒绝。

qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.v3-res.en: How long the Runtime Broker keeps waiting for the worker's result of a dispatched Shell or Monitor execution that publishes its output (Tool v3, with `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.enabled`) before marking it `UNKNOWN`; a value shorter than the longest such call turns that call into `UNKNOWN`. Other tool executions do not use this window. A value above `30m` buys nothing on the shipped path: the Hosted Harness stops waiting for a Tool v3 execution after its own fixed 30 minutes. A suffix-less number binds as seconds. Startup refuses a value below `1s`.
qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.v3-res.zh: Runtime Broker 等待 worker 返回已派发的、会发布输出的 Shell 或 Monitor 执行（Tool v3，开启 `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.enabled` 时使用）结果的最长时间，超时后把该执行标记为 `UNKNOWN`；若短于最长的此类调用，该调用会变成 `UNKNOWN`。其他工具执行不使用此窗口。大于 `30m` 在随发行版提供的执行路径上没有作用：Hosted Harness 自身等待 Tool v3 执行的期限固定为 30 分钟。不带单位的数字按秒解析。低于 `1s` 时启动时拒绝。

qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.verifi.en: Whether LOCAL Workspace execution is gated on a verified physical storage registration: before tools, file access or child Git run, the server checks that the Workspace root still matches its registered identity and marker, and otherwise refuses with `409 workspace_unavailable`. Required by `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.workspace-creation-root` and `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.local-directory-import-enabled`; without `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.workspace-mounts` it also satisfies the Workspace source that `qwen.managed-agent.harness.workspace-files-enabled` needs. Startup refuses it with external provisioners and resident Workspaces.
qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.verifi.zh: LOCAL Workspace 的执行是否以已验证的物理存储登记为前提：在工具、文件访问或子 Git 操作运行前，服务端检查 Workspace 根目录是否仍与登记的身份和标记一致，否则以 `409 workspace_unavailable` 拒绝。`qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.workspace-creation-root` 和 `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.local-directory-import-enabled` 都依赖它；未配置 `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.workspace-mounts` 时，它也满足 `qwen.managed-agent.harness.workspace-files-enabled` 对 Workspace 来源的要求。与外部 provisioner 或常驻 Workspace 同时使用时启动时拒绝。

qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.worker.en: Path to the built Qwen Code CLI bundle (for example `dist/cli.js`) that `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.node-executable` runs with `managed-runtime-worker` to start local-process workers; LOCAL Workspace file-reference checks and uploads also run through it. Required when `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.provisioner` is `local-process`; a relative path resolves against the server's working directory.
qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.worker.zh: 已构建的 Qwen Code CLI 包路径（例如 `dist/cli.js`），由 `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.node-executable` 以 `managed-runtime-worker` 参数运行，以启动 local-process worker；LOCAL Workspace 的文件引用检查和上传也通过它执行。`qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.provisioner` 为 `local-process` 时必填；相对路径按服务端的工作目录解析。

qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.worksp.en: An existing canonical directory the server account can write, under which it creates new empty Workspaces in per-tenant subdirectories when users start a Workspace from scratch; empty disables Workspace creation. It must not overlap any `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.workspace-mounts` root, `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.state-directory` or `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.workspace-cwd`, and requires `qwen.managed-agent.harness.workspace-files-enabled`, `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.durable-local-process` and `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.verified-workspace-recovery-enabled`; startup refuses otherwise and with external provisioners. Any authenticated tenant actor can then allocate storage there and becomes its owner.
qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.worksp.zh: 已存在、规范化且服务账号可写的目录，用户“从零开始”创建 Workspace 时，服务端在其下按租户分子目录新建空 Workspace；留空则禁用 Workspace 创建。它不得与任何 `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.workspace-mounts` 根目录、`qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.state-directory` 或 `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.workspace-cwd` 重叠，并要求启用 `qwen.managed-agent.harness.workspace-files-enabled`、`qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.durable-local-process` 和 `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.verified-workspace-recovery-enabled`；不满足条件或使用外部 provisioner 时启动时拒绝。启用后，任何已认证的租户用户都可以在其中分配存储并成为所有者。

qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.worksp.en: The working directory of the Broker's default Workspace, used by Sessions that are not bound to a registered Workspace. Required when `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.enabled` is true. With `local-process` it must exist and is resolved to its canonical path, from which the default workspace ID is derived (for the Session Store too, even while the Broker is disabled); `kubernetes-workspace` needs an absolute normalized path, and external provisioners an absolute normalized worker-side path other than `/`.
qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.worksp.zh: Broker 默认 Workspace 的工作目录，供未绑定已登记 Workspace 的 Session 使用。`qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.enabled` 为 true 时必填。使用 `local-process` 时目录必须存在，并被解析为规范路径，默认 workspace ID 由此派生（即使 Broker 未启用，Session Store 也会据此派生）；`kubernetes-workspace` 要求绝对且规范化的路径；外部 provisioner 要求 worker 侧的绝对规范化路径，且不能是 `/`。

qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.worksp.en: The generation of the Broker's default Workspace, carried in the Runtime scope of Sessions that are not bound to a registered Workspace. A non-empty string of at most 512 characters; required when `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.enabled` is true.
qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.worksp.zh: Broker 默认 Workspace 的代数（generation），写入未绑定已登记 Workspace 的 Session 的 Runtime 作用域。须为非空字符串，最长 512 个字符；`qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.enabled` 为 true 时必填。

qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.worksp.en: The ID of the Broker's default Workspace, which Sessions not bound to a registered Workspace share with the Session Store. With `local-process`, empty derives the first 16 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the canonical `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.workspace-cwd`, and a set value must equal that hash; other provisioners require it. With the Hosted Harness and Session Store enabled, startup refuses a value that differs from `qwen.managed-agent.session-store.workspace-id`. Keep it unchanged once Sessions exist, since unbound Sessions resolve their Store scope from it.
qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.worksp.zh: Broker 默认 Workspace 的 ID，未绑定已登记 Workspace 的 Session 与 Session Store 共用它。使用 `local-process` 时，留空则取规范化后 `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.workspace-cwd` 的 SHA-256 前 16 个十六进制字符，显式设置的值必须与之相同；其他 provisioner 必须显式设置。启用 Hosted Harness 和 Session Store 时，与 `qwen.managed-agent.session-store.workspace-id` 不一致则启动时拒绝。已有 Session 后不要修改，因为未绑定的 Session 依据它解析 Store 作用域。

qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.worksp.en: The administrator-mounted Workspace storage roots, set in a configuration file (YAML) as a list of entries with `tenant-id`, `storage-id` and `root`. Each `root` must be an existing canonical directory; roots must not overlap or alias each other, and each tenant and storage pair may appear once. Requires the `local-process` provisioner; startup refuses otherwise and with external provisioners or resident Workspaces. Every Broker sharing the database must use the same list.
qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.worksp.zh: 管理员挂载的 Workspace 存储根目录，在配置文件（YAML）中以列表设置，每项包含 `tenant-id`、`storage-id` 和 `root`。每个 `root` 必须是已存在的规范化目录；各根目录不得重叠或互为别名，同一租户与存储的组合只能出现一次。要求 `local-process` provisioner；否则，或与外部 provisioner、常驻 Workspace 同时使用时，启动时拒绝。共享同一数据库的所有 Broker 必须使用相同的列表。

qwen.managed-agent.service-user.en: The operating-system account the server runs as. Only the preflight check reads it: it confirms the account exists and checks that the configuration and credentials files are readable by that account rather than by the account running preflight. Empty checks access as the account running preflight.
qwen.managed-agent.service-user.zh: 服务端运行所用的操作系统账号。仅预检会读取该值：确认账号存在，并按该账号（而非运行预检的账号）检查配置文件和凭据文件是否可读。为空时按运行预检的账号检查访问权限。

qwen.managed-agent.session-store.allow-i.en: Whether a plaintext `http` `qwen.managed-agent.session-store.base-url` on a non-loopback host is accepted. Without it startup refuses such a URL, which every Harness would reject; with it the flag is passed to the Harness in each Session's Store descriptor so its client accepts the URL.
qwen.managed-agent.session-store.allow-i.zh: 是否接受指向非回环主机的明文 `http` `qwen.managed-agent.session-store.base-url`。未开启时此类 URL 启动时拒绝（所有 Harness 都会拒绝它）；开启后该标志会随每个 Session 的 Store 描述发送给 Harness，使其客户端接受该 URL。

qwen.managed-agent.session-store.base-ur.en: The URL at which the Hosted Harness reaches this server's Session Store routes. Empty derives the loopback `http` URL of the serving listener (the internal one when `qwen.managed-agent.internal-server.port` is set) if it binds a blank, wildcard, `127.0.0.1` or `::1` address on a fixed port without TLS; otherwise set it. Startup refuses non-loopback plaintext `http` unless `qwen.managed-agent.session-store.allow-insecure-http`, and a loopback URL off the internal port. The `managed-local` profile requires a loopback `http` URL.
qwen.managed-agent.session-store.base-ur.zh: Hosted Harness 访问本服务 Session Store 路由所用的 URL。为空时，若提供这些路由的监听器（设置了 `qwen.managed-agent.internal-server.port` 时为内部监听器）在固定端口上绑定空、通配、`127.0.0.1` 或 `::1` 地址且未启用 TLS，则自动推导为其回环 `http` URL；否则必须显式设置。指向非回环主机的明文 `http`（除非开启 `qwen.managed-agent.session-store.allow-insecure-http`），以及未指向内部端口的回环 URL，均启动时拒绝。`managed-local` profile 要求回环 `http` URL。

qwen.managed-agent.session-store.binding.en: The secret HMAC key from which the control plane issues each Session's Store writer credential to the Harness; with it the Store rejects any other token, without it the Harness mints its own (first writer wins). At least 32 bytes. Required by the Harness pool, and before the internal surface leaves loopback unless `qwen.managed-agent.auth.allow-insecure-bind`; must differ from `qwen.managed-agent.auth.signing-key`.
qwen.managed-agent.session-store.binding.zh: 机密 HMAC 密钥，控制面据此为每个 Session 向 Harness 签发 Store 写入凭据；配置后 Store 拒绝其他任何 token，未配置时由 Harness 自行生成（先写者获胜）。至少 32 字节。Harness 池需要它；内部接口离开回环地址前也需要它（除非开启 `qwen.managed-agent.auth.allow-insecure-bind`）；必须与 `qwen.managed-agent.auth.signing-key` 不同。

qwen.managed-agent.session-store.enabled.en: Whether this server serves the private Session Store routes under `/internal/managed-session-store/v1/` and gives Hosted Sessions a Store descriptor. Startup requires it while `qwen.managed-agent.harness.enabled` is true; Workspace files and the Harness pool need it too. It exposes the internal surface, so leaving loopback then needs `qwen.managed-agent.session-store.binding-key` unless `qwen.managed-agent.auth.allow-insecure-bind` is true. Unless set, the packaged configuration follows `qwen.managed-agent.harness.enabled`.
qwen.managed-agent.session-store.enabled.zh: 本服务是否提供 `/internal/managed-session-store/v1/` 下的私有 Session Store 路由，并为 Hosted Session 下发 Store 描述。`qwen.managed-agent.harness.enabled` 为 true 时必须开启，否则启动时拒绝；Workspace 文件功能和 Harness 池也依赖它。开启后会暴露内部接口，因此离开回环地址需要 `qwen.managed-agent.session-store.binding-key`，除非 `qwen.managed-agent.auth.allow-insecure-bind` 为 true。未显式设置时，打包配置跟随 `qwen.managed-agent.harness.enabled`。

qwen.managed-agent.session-store.workspa.en: The workspace ID that scopes the Store for Sessions not bound to a Workspace; bound Sessions use their own Workspace ID. Empty takes `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.workspace-id`, otherwise the ID a `local-process` Broker derives from `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.workspace-cwd`. Startup refuses it empty while the Harness uses the Store, and different from a set Runtime Broker ID. Keep it unchanged on an existing deployment.
qwen.managed-agent.session-store.workspa.zh: 未绑定 Workspace 的 Session 在 Store 中使用的 workspace ID 作用域；绑定 Workspace 的 Session 使用其自身的 Workspace ID。为空时取 `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.workspace-id`，否则取 `local-process` Broker 从 `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.workspace-cwd` 推导出的 ID。Harness 使用 Store 时为空，或与已设置的 Runtime Broker ID 不同，均启动时拒绝。已有部署不要修改此值。

qwen.managed-agent.session-store.writer-.en: How long a Harness's writer lease on a Session's Store journal lasts before it must be renewed; also how long Session close or delete admission keeps an already-live writer. Must be between `1s` and `300s`: a value outside fails each Session's Harness create or load rather than startup. A number without a unit is read as seconds.
qwen.managed-agent.session-store.writer-.zh: Harness 对 Session 的 Store 日志持有的写入租约在必须续约之前的有效时长；也是受理 Session 关闭或删除时保留已有活跃写入者的时长。必须在 `1s` 到 `300s` 之间：超出范围不会在启动时报错，而是使每个 Session 的 Harness 创建或加载失败。不带单位的数字按秒解析。

qwen.managed-agent.session-worktree.scan.en: How long the Session worktree pass waits between runs; each run resumes pending per-Session Git worktree steps and fails the initial Turns of Sessions whose worktree could not be prepared. Accepts a duration such as `1s`; a plain number is milliseconds.
qwen.managed-agent.session-worktree.scan.zh: Session worktree 任务两次运行之间的间隔；每次运行继续未完成的单 Session Git worktree 步骤，并使 worktree 未能准备好的 Session 的初始 Turn 失败。接受 `1s` 这类时长；不带单位的数字按毫秒计。

qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.acti.en: How many tool output captures one tenant may have open at the same time; a further reservation is refused until one finishes. Required when `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.enabled` is true; must be at least 1 (startup refusal).
qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.acti.zh: 单个租户可同时处于打开状态的工具输出捕获数量；达到上限后新的预留会被拒绝，直到有捕获结束。`qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.enabled` 为 true 时必填，且至少为 `1`（否则启动时拒绝）。

qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.asyn.en: Whether clients may ask for asynchronous verification of publication operations with the `X-Qwen-Tool-Publication-Async: 1` header, receiving HTTP 202 and polling for the outcome; otherwise every operation verifies synchronously. Turning it off stops new asynchronous admissions while already accepted operations still drain.
qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.asyn.zh: 是否允许客户端通过 `X-Qwen-Tool-Publication-Async: 1` 请求头为发布操作申请异步校验（先返回 HTTP 202，再轮询结果）；关闭时所有操作均同步校验。关闭后不再接纳新的异步操作，已接纳的操作仍会继续校验完毕。

qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.clai.en: How long a server's claim on an in-progress publication operation lasts; the holder renews it every third of this period, and a retry can take the operation over only after the claim lapses. Required when tool publication is enabled; must be positive and shorter than `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.operation-timeout` (startup refusal). A bare number is seconds.
qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.clai.zh: 服务端对进行中的发布操作持有认领的时长；持有者每隔该时长的三分之一续期一次，认领失效后重试请求才能接管该操作。启用工具发布时必填，必须为正且短于 `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.operation-timeout`（否则启动时拒绝）。不带单位的数字按秒解析。

qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.dele.en: How long a retired Session's tool output and Session resources are kept before garbage collection may delete them. Only takes effect with `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.gc-enabled`; the periodic retention log sample also uses it. Must not be negative (startup refusal when tool publication is enabled). A bare number is seconds.
qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.dele.zh: 已退役 Session 的工具输出和 Session 资源在可被垃圾回收删除之前的保留时长。仅在开启 `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.gc-enabled` 时生效；周期性的保留情况日志采样也使用该值。不得为负（启用工具发布时，否则启动时拒绝）。不带单位的数字按秒解析。

qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.enab.en: Whether the server accepts tool output publication: Hosted Shell executions stream their output through the internal `/internal/managed-tool-publications` API into object storage (Aliyun OSS unless a custom store bean is registered). Startup is refused unless this group's service URL, capacities and deadlines are set, plus the OSS endpoint, region and bucket. Off a loopback address it also requires `qwen.managed-agent.session-store.binding-key`, unless `qwen.managed-agent.auth.allow-insecure-bind` is true.
qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.enab.zh: 服务端是否接受工具输出发布：Hosted Shell 执行通过内部 `/internal/managed-tool-publications` API 将输出流式写入对象存储（未注册自定义存储 bean 时为阿里云 OSS）。必须同时设置本组的服务 URL、容量和期限，以及 OSS endpoint、region 和 bucket，否则启动时拒绝。内部接口不在回环地址上时还需要 `qwen.managed-agent.session-store.binding-key`，除非 `qwen.managed-agent.auth.allow-insecure-bind` 为 true。

qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.entr.en: How many tool publication API requests this server process handles at once; a request beyond that gets HTTP 429 `managed_tool_publication_busy`. Required when tool publication is enabled; must be at least 1 (startup refusal).
qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.entr.zh: 本服务进程可同时处理的工具发布 API 请求数；超出的请求返回 HTTP 429 `managed_tool_publication_busy`。启用工具发布时必填，且至少为 `1`（否则启动时拒绝）。

qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.exec.en: How many bytes of output one tool execution may capture; it is also sent to the Harness as the capture limit for Shell and team-lead executions. Required when tool publication is enabled; must be between 1 byte and 2 TiB (2^41 bytes). Startup is refused if verifying that much output would exceed `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.max-verification-timeout`.
qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.exec.zh: 单次工具执行最多可捕获的输出字节数；该值也会作为 Shell 与 team-lead 执行的捕获上限传给 Harness。启用工具发布时必填，取值范围为 1 字节到 2 TiB（2^41 字节）。若校验这么多输出所需的时间超过 `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.max-verification-timeout`，启动时拒绝。

qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.gc-e.en: Whether the server garbage-collects retired tool output: capture objects in object storage and the stored resources of retired Sessions, once `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.deletion-grace` has passed. Only read when `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.enabled` is true.
qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.gc-e.zh: 服务端是否对已退役的工具输出做垃圾回收：在超过 `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.deletion-grace` 后，删除对象存储中的捕获对象以及已退役 Session 存储的资源。仅当 `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.enabled` 为 true 时读取。

qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.max-.en: The longest deadline a publication verification may get. Must be positive and at most 25 minutes; startup is refused if `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.operation-timeout` plus the time to verify `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.execution-bytes` (and a fixed producer allowance) at `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.verification-bytes-per-second` exceeds it. Required when tool publication is enabled. A bare number is seconds.
qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.max-.zh: 发布校验可获得的最长期限。必须为正且不超过 25 分钟；若 `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.operation-timeout` 加上按 `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.verification-bytes-per-second` 校验 `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.execution-bytes`（外加固定的 producer 额度）所需的时间超过该值，启动时拒绝。启用工具发布时必填。不带单位的数字按秒解析。

qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.oper.en: How long a publication operation (upload, verification or finish) may run before its deadline; verifying stored content adds one second per `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.verification-bytes-per-second` bytes. Required when tool publication is enabled; must be positive and longer than `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.claim-timeout` (startup refusal). A bare number is seconds.
qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.oper.zh: 发布操作（上传、校验或完成）在到期前可运行的时长；校验已存储内容时，每 `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.verification-bytes-per-second` 字节额外增加一秒。启用工具发布时必填，必须为正且长于 `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.claim-timeout`（否则启动时拒绝）。不带单位的数字按秒解析。

qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.oss-.en: The Aliyun OSS bucket that stores tool output objects. Required when tool publication is enabled with the default OSS store (startup refusal); ignored when a custom `ToolPublicationObjectStore` bean is registered.
qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.oss-.zh: 存放工具输出对象的阿里云 OSS bucket。启用工具发布且使用默认 OSS 存储时必填（否则启动时拒绝）；注册了自定义 `ToolPublicationObjectStore` bean 时忽略。

qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.oss-.en: The Aliyun OSS endpoint for tool output objects. Must be `https://oss-<region>.aliyuncs.com` for `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.oss-region`, with no path, query or user info (startup refusal otherwise). OSS credentials are secrets read from the `OSS_ACCESS_KEY_ID` and `OSS_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET` environment variables (plus `OSS_SESSION_TOKEN` for a temporary token). Required with the default OSS store; ignored when a custom store bean is registered.
qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.oss-.zh: 工具输出对象使用的阿里云 OSS endpoint。必须是与 `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.oss-region` 对应的 `https://oss-<region>.aliyuncs.com`，且不带路径、查询参数或用户信息（否则启动时拒绝）。OSS 凭据属于 secret，从 `OSS_ACCESS_KEY_ID` 和 `OSS_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET` 环境变量读取（临时凭据另加 `OSS_SESSION_TOKEN`）。使用默认 OSS 存储时必填；注册了自定义存储 bean 时忽略。

qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.oss-.en: The Aliyun OSS region (for example `cn-hangzhou`) used for V4 request signing; it must match the `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.oss-endpoint` host. Required with the default OSS store (startup refusal); ignored when a custom store bean is registered.
qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.oss-.zh: 用于 V4 请求签名的阿里云 OSS region（例如 `cn-hangzhou`），必须与 `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.oss-endpoint` 的主机名一致。使用默认 OSS 存储时必填（否则启动时拒绝）；注册了自定义存储 bean 时忽略。

qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.serv.en: The base URL that Runtimes use to reach this server's tool publication API; they resolve `/internal/managed-tool-publications` against it. Must be an absolute `http` or `https` URL without path, query or fragment; plaintext `http` to a non-loopback host is refused unless `qwen.managed-agent.auth.allow-insecure-bind` is true. Required when tool publication is enabled. With SSH Runtime nodes configured it must be an `http` URL.
qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.serv.zh: Runtime 访问本服务工具发布 API 所用的基础 URL，Runtime 会基于它解析 `/internal/managed-tool-publications`。必须是不带路径、查询参数或片段的绝对 `http` 或 `https` URL；指向非回环主机的明文 `http` 会在启动时被拒绝，除非 `qwen.managed-agent.auth.allow-insecure-bind` 为 true。启用工具发布时必填。配置了 SSH Runtime 节点时必须为 `http` URL。

qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.sess.en: How many bytes of tool output one Session may hold reserved across its captures; each reservation counts its capture size plus a fixed overhead of 4784128 bytes. A reservation that would exceed it is refused. Required when tool publication is enabled; must be at least 1 (startup refusal).
qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.sess.zh: 单个 Session 所有捕获合计可预留的工具输出字节数；每次预留按其捕获大小加上固定的 `4784128` 字节开销计算。超出该值的预留会被拒绝。启用工具发布时必填，且至少为 `1`（否则启动时拒绝）。

qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.tena.en: How many bytes of tool output one tenant may hold reserved across all its Sessions' captures; each reservation counts its capture size plus a fixed overhead of 4784128 bytes. A reservation that would exceed it is refused. Required when tool publication is enabled; must be at least 1 (startup refusal).
qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.tena.zh: 单个租户在其所有 Session 的捕获中合计可预留的工具输出字节数；每次预留按其捕获大小加上固定的 `4784128` 字节开销计算。超出该值的预留会被拒绝。启用工具发布时必填，且至少为 `1`（否则启动时拒绝）。

qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.veri.en: The verification throughput floor in bytes per second: a verification deadline is `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.operation-timeout` plus one second for each this many bytes being verified, and must stay within `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.max-verification-timeout`. Required when tool publication is enabled; must be at least 1 (startup refusal).
qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.veri.zh: 校验吞吐量下限（字节/秒）：校验期限为 `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.operation-timeout` 加上每校验这么多字节增加的一秒，且不得超过 `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.max-verification-timeout`。启用工具发布时必填，且至少为 `1`（否则启动时拒绝）。

qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.veri.en: How many background threads verify asynchronously admitted publication operations. The verifier keeps running when `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.async-verification-enabled` is turned off, so accepted operations drain. Must be at least 1 (startup refusal when tool publication is enabled).
qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.veri.zh: 对已异步接纳的发布操作进行校验的后台线程数。关闭 `qwen.managed-agent.tool-publication.async-verification-enabled` 后校验器仍会运行，以便处理完已接纳的操作。至少为 `1`（启用工具发布时，否则启动时拒绝）。

qwen.managed-agent.trusted-actor-header.en: The name of a request header (for example `X-Qwen-Actor-Id`) whose value is trusted as the caller's actor ID, together with `X-Qwen-Tenant-Id`, when no upstream principal is present. Used only in open authentication mode; combining it with signed mode is refused at startup. In open mode, `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.local-directory-import-enabled` requires it. Never set it where untrusted clients can reach the server. Empty disables it.
qwen.managed-agent.trusted-actor-header.zh: 一个请求头名称（例如 `X-Qwen-Actor-Id`），在没有上游认证主体时，其值连同 `X-Qwen-Tenant-Id` 一起被信任为调用方的 actor ID。仅在 open 认证模式下使用；与 signed 模式同时配置时启动时拒绝。open 模式下开启 `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.local-directory-import-enabled` 时必须设置本项。切勿在不可信客户端能访问服务端的环境中设置。为空时禁用。

qwen.managed-agent.wake-recovery.scan-de.en: How long the wake recovery scan waits between passes; each pass finds up to eight Sessions holding committed inputs that no writer owns and reattaches them so their wake runs. Runs only with `qwen.managed-agent.session-store.enabled` and an available Hosted Harness. Accepts a duration such as `2s`; a plain number is milliseconds.
qwen.managed-agent.wake-recovery.scan-de.zh: 唤醒恢复扫描两次运行之间的间隔；每次运行最多找出 8 个存有已提交输入但无写入者持有的 Session，并重新挂接以运行其唤醒。仅在开启 `qwen.managed-agent.session-store.enabled` 且 Hosted Harness 可用时运行。接受 `2s` 这类时长；不带单位的数字按毫秒计。

server.address.en: The address the public HTTP listener binds to. A non-loopback address needs `qwen.managed-agent.auth.mode=signed`; under `auto` or `open` mode startup refuses it unless `qwen.managed-agent.auth.allow-insecure-bind` is true. While the internal routes share this listener (no `qwen.managed-agent.internal-server.port`) and the Session Store or tool publication is on, a non-loopback address also needs `qwen.managed-agent.session-store.binding-key` unless `qwen.managed-agent.auth.allow-insecure-bind` is true. The `managed-local` profile refuses any non-loopback address.
server.address.zh: 公共 HTTP 监听器绑定的地址。非回环地址需要 `qwen.managed-agent.auth.mode=signed`；在 `auto` 或 `open` 模式下，除非 `qwen.managed-agent.auth.allow-insecure-bind` 为 true，否则启动时拒绝。内部路由与该监听器共用（未设置 `qwen.managed-agent.internal-server.port`）且开启了 Session Store 或工具发布时，非回环地址还需要 `qwen.managed-agent.session-store.binding-key`，除非 `qwen.managed-agent.auth.allow-insecure-bind` 为 true。`managed-local` profile 下非回环地址一律启动时拒绝。

server.port.en: The port of the public listener the API and `/actuator/health` are served on. Spring Boot reads it from `SERVER_PORT`.
server.port.zh: 公共监听端口，API 和 `/actuator/health` 都在该端口上提供。Spring Boot 从 `SERVER_PORT` 读取。

spring.datasource.druid.max-active.en: How many connections the control plane's Druid database pool may hold at most. When all are busy, a request for a connection waits up to 30 seconds and then fails. Ignored under the `managed-local` profile, whose pool is fixed at 20.
spring.datasource.druid.max-active.zh: 控制面 Druid 数据库连接池最多可持有的连接数。连接全部占用时，获取连接的请求最多等待 30 秒，随后失败。`managed-local` profile 下不生效，其连接池固定为 20。

spring.datasource.password.en: The password of `spring.datasource.username`. A secret: keep it in a private environment file such as `server.env`, not on a command line.
spring.datasource.password.zh: `spring.datasource.username` 的密码。属于机密：应放在 `server.env` 这类私有环境文件中，不要写在命令行上。

spring.datasource.url.en: The JDBC URL of the MySQL 8 database that holds the control plane's state; Flyway applies the schema migrations to it at startup. The `managed-local` profile replaces it with a private H2 file database and refuses any other URL.
spring.datasource.url.zh: 存放控制面状态的 MySQL 8 数据库的 JDBC URL；启动时 Flyway 会对其执行 schema 迁移。`managed-local` profile 改用私有 H2 文件数据库，其他 URL 启动时拒绝。

spring.datasource.username.en: The database user the control plane connects as. Besides rights on the control plane's database, it needs `SELECT` on `performance_schema.user_variables_by_thread`, which the preflight `--check` verifies.
spring.datasource.username.zh: 控制面连接数据库所用的用户。除控制面数据库的权限外，还需要 `performance_schema.user_variables_by_thread` 的 `SELECT` 权限，预检 `--check` 会校验该权限。
